reviews.archiveDescription: This page keeps the long-term history out of the homepage while still letting you revisit every monthly and quarterly review.
reviews.monthlyEntryDescription: Save the final monthly review here after deciding what should and should not count.
reviews.quarterlyEntryDescription: Keep net-worth check-ins in the archive workspace instead of on the homepage.

sharedAccount.title: Who used how much?
sharedAccount.description: Keep the common-account workflow separate from the main dashboard and review it here whenever you need it.

home.heroTitle: Review your month, track your net worth, and keep the shared account honest.
home.heroDescription: This workspace combines monthly reviews, quarterly net-worth check-ins, fixed-cost tracking, investment snapshots, and a shared-account ledger with ownership splits.
home.ritualMonthly: Monthly: income, expense split, investment rate, notes, and actions.
home.ritualQuarterly: Quarterly: main account, emergency fund, investments, crypto, debts, net worth.
home.ritualShared: Shared account: who really used what, including 50/50 household spending.
home.yourUsageVs: Your usage vs {other} for the other person
home.monthlyTrendDescription: Income minus expenses and investments for {year}, so you can see whether the month created room or pressure.
home.quarterlyTrendDescription: A clearer balance-sheet view for {year} based on active assets minus debts.
home.workspacesTitle: Use focused pages for the long workflows
home.workspacesDescription: The dashboard stays short, while the heavier workflows live in dedicated pages.
home.sideWorkspacesDescription: Import and categorize Cashew data, or manage the shared account separately from the main dashboard.
home.importsWorkspaceDescription: Open this page to import files, inspect transactions, include or exclude rows, and prepare monthly review totals by category.
home.sharedWorkspaceDescription: Keep the common-account ledger, usage split, and CSV export in its own dedicated page so the dashboard stays compact.
home.recentReviewsDescription: The homepage keeps the latest four reviews visible. Older ones live in the archive by year.
home.fixedCostsDescription: Keep a live list of recurring expenses so you can see the drag they create before variable spending even starts.
home.investmentsDescription: Use each entry as an account snapshot: name it clearly, pick the account, add the new contribution, and record the current total value on that date.
